name: Blackchar Cave
summary: Blackchar Cave is a mysterious, sealed-off cavern tucked into the southwestern crags of Searing Gorge, close to the base of Blackrock Mountain. Its entrance is choked with impassable rubble and rock.

sections.title: A Sealed Threshold
sections.body: Tucked away against the scorching crags near the approaches to Blackrock Mountain, Blackchar Cave presents a solid wall of stone where a deep cavern entrance might once have been. Heavy rubble and scorched slag choke the opening, preventing anyone from exploring whatever tunnels lie deeper within the mountain roots. The desolate terrain around it is scorched by ash and magma, offering little comfort to wanderers.

faq.q: Can you go inside Blackchar Cave?
faq.answer: No. The entrance to Blackchar Cave is completely sealed off by collapsed rock, ash, and rubble. There is no open interior space to explore.
It is located in the southwestern corner of Searing Gorge, situated along the rocky foothills near the passage toward Blackrock Mountain.
